# Refstream.js browser distribution

Vendored from [`refstream.js` v0.1.0-alpha.5](https://github.com/TeoSlayer/refstream.js/releases/tag/v0.1.0-alpha.5), commit `131a71335f05344f3018c43a76ffbe7376493a34`.

The upstream `refstream.js-0.1.0-alpha.5-browser.zip` archive was verified against its published `SHA256SUMS` before these files were copied. The two declaration files describe the stable browser embedding surface used by shell.online.
